notes: `בֶּהָרִים`: the ASV promotes the object to a bare direct object — *Touch the mountains* — so the `בְּ` is `unrepresented` under rule 40 while its assimilated article takes the written *the* (rule 12).
The supplied *O* stands before the vocative name and is the noun's under rule 36, discontinuous from it under rule 25.
